description: This file contains a class 'BcgSR' that provides string resources, error messages, and validation messages for barcode rendering within the PDFsharp library, specifically for barcode types such as 2 of 5, 3 of 9, DataMatrix, and OMR marks.

classes.name: BcgSR
classes.description: A static class providing resource strings and validation messages related to barcode rendering.

methods.name: Invalid2Of5Code
methods.description: Returns an error message if the provided code for an interleave 2 of 5 barcode is invalid.

methods.name: Invalid3Of9Code
methods.description: Returns an error message if the provided code for a 3 of 9 barcode is invalid.

methods.name: BarCodeNotSet
methods.description: Message indicating that the barcode text must be set before rendering.

methods.name: EmptyBarCodeSize
methods.description: Message indicating that a non-empty size must be established before rendering the barcode.

methods.name: Invalid2of5Relation
methods.description: Error message for invalid ratio between thick and thin lines in interleaved 2 of 5 barcode.

methods.name: InvalidMarkName
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an invalid mark name for OMR.

methods.name: OmrAlreadyInitialized
methods.description: Indicates that mark descriptions cannot be modified after marks have been set.

methods.name: DataMatrixTooBig
methods.description: Error message for when data and encoding size exceed DataMatrix capabilities.

methods.name: DataMatrixNotSupported
methods.description: Message indicating that certain sizes or encoding types of DataMatrix are unsupported.

methods.name: DataMatrixNull
methods.description: Indicates no DataMatrix code has been generated.

methods.name: DataMatrixInvalid
methods.description: Returns an error message for invalid dimensions of DataMatrix.
